compute_rasa: compute windowed relative solvent accessible area from a CIF string using the AlphaFold-RSA method
compute_fraction_disordered: compute the fraction of disordered protein residues in a Structure using rASA metrics
detect_clashes: detect whether a protein structure has clashing chains by checking atom-atom distances below a cutoff radius
compute_ranking_score: compute a combined ranking score from pTM, ipTM, fraction disordered, and clash penalty metrics
compute_predicted_tm_score: compute the predicted TM alignment or interface TM alignment score from tm_adjusted_pae and pair mask
